verdict.rationale: Retell's own docs show a voice selector where developers can search and add ElevenLabs community voices, import voice clones, or train clones via the API. A founder comment says OpenAI TTS, Deepgram, and ElevenLabs are available at different prices, which suggests multiple TTS providers, but no first-party doc describes choosing among or plugging in providers. missing for 10: first-party documentation of multi-provider TTS selection or plug-in, documentation of the size of the built-in voice library, independent hands-on corroboration of voice breadth.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose from a broad voice library or plug in multiple TTS providers to get the voice I want

citations.quote: Add custom voices to your Retell agent — search ElevenLabs community voices, import a voice clone, or train a clone for a unique brand-specific sound.
In the voice selector, you can click "Add custom voice" to search and add publicly available community voices.
Audio files to use for voice cloning. Up to 25 files allowed.
The different providers have different prices. openai tts & deepgram are cheaper, 11labs are higher.
